known_limitations: Implements the reviewed requirements as a compact demo application rather than a full enterprise workbench.
Role permissions, conflict handling, import staging, notifications, and glossary checks are represented in a simplified in-memory/persistent JSON model.
Does not integrate with external document repositories or issue-tracking systems yet.
Does not provide full offline editing or advanced autosave/sync state management.
Does not implement a complete approval workflow, audit-grade reporting, or all unresolved deployment options.
